title: The Envy of Hyle: How the Corrupt Matrix Counterfeits the Divine Likeness
description: Envy is the primal substance of Hyle, operating by counterfeiting whatever the Lord has revealed. Four envyings: of the First Man's garment (stained); of the Ambassador's icon (counterfeited as somatic Adam — a true seal pressed into corrupt wax); of Adam (power snatched, Eve begotten in his likeness); of Christ with his Righteousness and the cross. Envy is the wickedness that casts the soul out of the kind of the Living One.
